entities.summary: Graham Saxton Vigrass is a Canadian university head coach and a former professional and Canadian national team volleyball player. He was a participant at two Olympic Games and a bronze medallist at the 2017 World League. He became the head coach of the University of Calgary Dinos men's volleyball team in 2024.
